steps.name: w6_uistate_toggle_before
steps.script: var bandTitles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.r-band h4')).map(function(h){return h.textContent;}); var sel = document.querySelector('.derived select'); if (!sel) return 'NO_TOGGLE'; return JSON.stringify({toggle: sel.value, options: Array.from(sel.options).map(function(o){return o.value;}), bandTitles: bandTitles, bandRegions: document.querySelectorAll('.r-band').length});

steps.name: w6_uistate_toggle_switch
steps.script: var sel = document.querySelector('.derived select'); if (!sel) return 'NO_TOGGLE'; var target = Array.from(sel.options).map(function(o){return o.value;}).filter(function(v){ return v !== sel.value; })[0]; sel.value = target; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return 'switched to:' + target;
steps.label: W6: switch the declared toggle -- the visible surface set must change
